kept.title: GitHub - keylime/keylime: A CNCF Project to Bootstrap & Maintain Trust ...
kept.snippet: Keylime consists of three main components; The Verifier, Registrar and the Agent. The Verifier continuously verifies the integrity state of the machine that the agent is running on. The Registrar is a database of all agents registered with Keylime and hosts the public keys of the TPM vendors.

kept.title: Keylime
kept.snippet: Keylime is a CNCF hosted project that provides a highly scalable remote boot attestation and runtime integrity measurement solution. Keylime enables users to monitor remote nodes using a hardware based cryptographic root of trust.

kept.title: TPM Attestation | keylime/keylime | DeepWiki
kept.snippet: TPM attestation in Keylime uses the TPM 2.0 specification to generate cryptographically signed quotes containing PCR values and other integrity measurements. The Cloud Verifier requests quotes from agents and validates them using the agent's Attestation Identity Key (AIK), which itself is verified through the TPM's Endorsement Key (EK) hierarchy.
